newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CAPITAL MKT COMMISSION OKS IFC BONDS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CAPITAL MKT COMMISSION OKS IFC BONDS.

text.p: Greece's capital markets commission said in a statement that it approved two International Finance Corporation bond issues for 26.7 billion drachmas.
The commission also decided to suspend three Athens stock exchange members from trading until Friday November 22. The brokers are Nikiforos Securities, AAGHS Brokerage and A.Giannopoulos Brokerage.
It granted an investment services (EPEY) licence to Alpha Trust and AKTIB, the statement said.
The commission also decided to impose new guarantee terms on Athens stock exchange members relative to their transactions. It did not specify any details.
It gave its conditional approval to the initial public offering of textiles firm Endysi for listing on the bourse's small-cap parallel market. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
